paper_title: Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism

model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of stimuli types within intra-agency news articles from Agency A, displaying a total of nine slices representing different categories. The largest slice, colored red, is labeled “Draft/Other” and occupies approximately 28.5% of the chart. Following this is a slice labeled “Press Release,” colored yellow, accounting for 21.9% of the total. Smaller slices include “Social Media Post” colored dark green at 1.5%, “External News Article” colored blue at 13.1%, “Organizational Website” colored gray at 6.6%, “Interview” colored light green at 10.2%, “Event Posting” colored orange at 8.8%, and “Organizational Report” colored brown at 8.2%. The chart contains percentage labels displayed inside each slice, and a legend is not included. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their area.
